title: PIPE-56 Blind Reconstruction — Phase 1
legalStatus: Retrospective controlled replay; Pipe 56 geometry and endpoint connection have been seen earlier in the project. This is NOT a previously unseen prospective blind study.

allowed: Documented manhole name and top WGS84 latitude/longitude
Historical rim elevation, outlet/main invert elevation and documented inlet levels
Historical pipe-opening inlet/outlet roles, recorded nominal diameters and recorded TCP material
blocked: All Gravity Main Line Layer 4 geometries, including OBJECTID 56
Historical pipe 56 recorded or measured length
Any precomputed line, route vertices, bearing derived from Pipe 56, or benchmark-derived connectivity
Any other information about the hidden pipe that is not independently documented as an allowed input
inputEvidence.selectedEndpoints: Two manhole locations were preselected by the tester. Existence of a connecting pipe must NOT be credited as independently discovered.
inputEvidence.references: Layer 1 attributes are historical AutoCAD-derived; not independently field-verified
inputEvidence.validationDistanceReference: EPSG:32617 metres for future route comparisons; define exact projection implementation before metric calculation
inputEvidence.levelConversion: ft to m using factor 0.3048 for the values previously recorded
inputEvidence.verticalDatum: Unknown / not established from reviewed GIS description; no absolute-depth correctness claim

openingLink.reason: opening role, diameters, gravity levels are consistent, but specific pipe-to-opening identity not independently documented in allowed manhole-only evidence

benchmark.referenceQuality: Historical digitized GIS record. Not a current subsurface survey or independent physical truth.

prospectiveRules.phase1: Create one separate local Test Case with exactly two evidenced manholes, zero observedPipes, zero calculated route outputs; preserve all existing projects
prospectiveRules.phase2: Freeze inference input / candidate before opening reference. Do not modify selection parameters using withheld geometry.
prospectiveRules.phase3: Any depth/crown/terrain assumptions must be documented independently, and unverified datum remains unknown.
prospectiveRules.phase4: Only then reveal separate reference and compute comparison metrics.

acceptanceCriteria.A1: Exactly 2 manholes with expected IDs 42 and 45 and recorded source values
acceptanceCriteria.A2: No observedPipes, GIS route geometry, reference length or historical benchmark values in the model input
acceptanceCriteria.A3: No currently rendered calculated pipe in Stage 1 (run not started)
acceptanceCriteria.A4: Original local project(s) and all imported records unchanged; test creation idempotent
acceptanceCriteria.A5: Source provenance and units captured; missing Vertical Datum and specific opening-to-pipe link marked Unverified
acceptanceCriteria.A6: Protocol and source snapshot committed before controlled rerun; the earlier exposure to Pipe 56 must be declared
acceptanceCriteria.A7: Only after Phase 2 lock, quantify reference agreement in metres: planimetric mean offset <= 1 m and maximum <= 2 m is a DEMO benchmark target, not field accuracy or guarantee
acceptanceCriteria.A8: Exact endpoint-based straight line matches are treated as a trivial baseline, not evidence of underground route discovery

successDefinition: Passing internal historical GIS agreement metrics is a limited retrospective demo, NOT proof of real-world 100% location accuracy or TRL4.
